items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Two years ago I took Johnny Letman on a tour for Honestier, and we had Ronnie Cole on the drums, we had George Kelly, we had Bill Pemberton, and I played the piano,and Fred Alonzo the trombone player

ctx.x: I took Johnny Letman on a tour in Europe a few days ago...and incidentally, I want to talk to you about Europe, too,

I want to tell you some of the things...good things that I think have happened. Two years ago I took Johnny Letman on a tour for Honestier, and we had Ronnie Cole on the drums, we had George Kelly, we had Bill Pemberton, and I played the piano,and Fred Alonzo the trombone player, a young man from New Orleans...a good trombone player that's one of the few trombone...promising trombone players that I've heard from Louisiana. I've heard him in Bern, Switzerland, year before last with Wally Davenport. I heard him in…

Now, I took Johnny Letman to Europe, '77, I think it was. We played...we were in Yugoslavia...we played Zagreb and Belgrade. We were in Portugal, Caïscas, played Paris...all over. All right? The highlight of that tour was when I introduced Johnny Letman and said, and I said it like this, "Ladies and Gentlemen, I would like to present a young man from America, steeped in the tradition of Louis Armstrong. Louis Armstrong has gone, and will not return, so I'm going to ask each of you here in this room to close your…
